Update14 August 2026·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
📜 Patch Notes - August 14, 2026
Voice Chat Beta goes live and some other event changes are happening.

🐉 Mounts & Pets

  • Fixed the camera distance when mounting the Typhoon Drake. Your current camera zoom will now be preserved when mounting.
  • Capiel apparently loved standing directly in players' faces. We've had a word with him, and he has reluctantly agreed to move out of the way.

Powerstone Pet Rework

Powerstone Pets have been completely reworked!

  • Existing Soul Fragments will now transform into fully-fledged Powerstone Pets when used.
  • Existing 30-days Powerstone Pets are unaffected and will expire naturally.
  • New Powerstone Pets now feature a dedicated Powerstone Slot:
    • Any Powerstone can be equipped in this slot.
    • The equipped Powerstone grants its passive and active skills directly to the pet.
  • This should also help reduce inventory clutter, as you'll no longer need to keep both a Soul Fragment and its associated pet around.

🎉 Anniversary

  • Windscour Savannah now has an active War/Peace Cycle for the remainder of the Anniversary celebrations.
  • The Fugitive has returned to Swirling Meadow!
  • The Swirling Meadow Cup is back, replacing the Ahnimar race for the remainder of the festival.
    • Race through Swirling Meadow every day to earn Festival Tokens!
  • Some of the Brave Warrior's Medal rewards have been adjusted
    • Great Golden Getaway: Brave Warrior's Medal reward 5 → 3
    • Capibaras and Their Tendency for Murder: Brave Warrior's Medal reward 4 → 6
    • A Harsh Lesson: replace 2× Warrior's Medal with 2× Brave Warrior's Medal

🎙️ Voice Chat Beta

  • In-Game Voice Chat is now available in Beta!
  • Communicate with nearby players through Proximity Voice, or talk with your entire group using Party & Raid Voice, regardless of distance.
  • Voice Chat can be enabled directly from the in-game settings.
  • This is still an experimental feature, so please report any issues you encounter!

👉 Read all about Voice Chat and how to use it here.

== 🐉 Mounts & Pets ==

* Fixed the camera distance when mounting the '''Typhoon Drake'''. Your current camera zoom will now be preserved when mounting.
* '''Capiel''' apparently loved standing directly in players' faces. We've had a word with him, and he has reluctantly agreed to move out of the way.

=== Powerstone Pet Rework ===

'''Powerstone Pets have been completely reworked!'''

* Existing '''Soul Fragments''' will now transform into fully-fledged '''Powerstone Pets''' when used.
* Existing 30-days Powerstone Pets are unaffected and will expire naturally.
* New Powerstone Pets now feature a dedicated '''Powerstone Slot''':
** Any Powerstone can be equipped in this slot.
** The equipped Powerstone grants its '''passive and active skills directly to the pet'''.
* This should also help reduce inventory clutter, as you'll no longer need to keep both a Soul Fragment and its associated pet around.

== 🎉 Anniversary ==

* '''Windscour Savannah''' now has an active '''War/Peace Cycle''' for the remainder of the Anniversary celebrations.
* '''The Fugitive''' has returned to '''Swirling Meadow'''!
* The '''Swirling Meadow Cup''' is back, replacing the Ahnimar race for the remainder of the festival.
** Race through Swirling Meadow every day to earn '''Festival Tokens'''!
* Some of the Brave Warrior's Medal rewards have been adjusted
** Great Golden Getaway: Brave Warrior's Medal reward 5 → 3
** Capibaras and Their Tendency for Murder: Brave Warrior's Medal reward 4 → 6
** A Harsh Lesson: replace 2× Warrior's Medal with 2× Brave Warrior's Medal

== 🎙️ Voice Chat Beta ==

* '''In-Game Voice Chat is now available in Beta!'''
* Communicate with nearby players through '''Proximity Voice''', or talk with your entire group using '''Party & Raid Voice''', regardless of distance.
* Voice Chat can be enabled directly from the in-game settings.
* This is still an '''experimental feature''', so please report any issues you encounter!

👉 '''[[News/Voice Chat Beta|Read all about Voice Chat and how to use it here.]]'''
